meta.title: TURB-Lagr Lagrangian trajectory glyphs
meta.description: One object per tracer particle in homogeneous isotropic turbulence. Each point is a timestep with five trajectory and local-flow channels: speed, acceleration magnitude, curvature, vorticity and dissipation.
meta.unit: point.values are dimensionless percentiles in (0,1); point.raw carries the same five channels in physical DNS units (see channelUnits)

encodings.values: Percentile of the raw value among all exported nodes of this file, ranked per channel. Distribution-free and comparable across channels - 0.9 means 'top 10 % here' on every fin - but it compresses magnitude: the 99th percentile and the maximum both sit near 1.0.
encodings.raw: The physical measurement at that node, at 6 significant digits. Use it for tooltips, for any statement in physical units, and for the log encoding below.
encodings.logFromRaw: Recommended second encoding: map log10(raw) linearly between the bounds in meta.logNormalization. It preserves ratios, so a burst that is five times the 99th percentile still looks larger, but a value is only comparable within its own channel.
encodings.linearFromRaw: Not recommended and not precomputed: these channels are heavy-tailed (curvature max / median ~ 550), so a linear map leaves >90 % of fins below 10 % of full length.

meta.normalizationPool: all 12500 exported nodes (125 particles x 100 beads); percentiles are relative to this file, not to the full 500 x 2000 DNS subset

channelUnits.dissipation: 2*nu*S:S, energy per unit mass per unit time
